g.text: The life of one message, from show() to gone
Draw (when the message is among the first maxVisible)
A text message skips the lambda:
Close (time is up, close button, swipe, an action, or dismiss from code)
remove the entry once the exit has ended
The next queued message, if any,
now becomes visible and its timer starts.
Replace (show with a key that is still alive)
